g.text: Does repairing one visual association preserve other uses?
Held-out source photographs; annotations are correct / attempted questions. Two overlay positions share each photo.
Text cards are controlled word-reading tasks, not natural-scene OCR. *Oracle masking knows the synthetic overlay location and task.
